maddeler.e:
احتكرا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرَا (iḥtakarā) /iħ.ta.ka.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اُحْتُكِرَا (uḥtukirā) /uħ.tu.ki.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكِرَا (iḥtakirā) /iħ.ta.ki.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
